fields.name: StringExtensions internal checksum-embedded external key codec
fields.contract: SerializeToExternalString prepends a 2-character checksum to the URL-safe encoding of the input bytes. It accumulates a 12-bit running sum of the original byte values, then XOR-obfuscates each byte with a 6-byte repeating mask (119, 78, 180, 92, 83, 77 selected by byte position modulo 6) before URL-safe-encoding the obfuscated bytes via EncodeToString; the two checksum characters encode the high 6 bits and low 6 bits of the accumulated sum. SerializeFromExternalString reverses this: it reads the leading 2 characters as the expected checksum, URL-safe-decodes the remaining characters, XOR-deobfuscates each byte with the same repeating mask while recomputing the 12-bit sum over the de-obfuscated bytes, and throws a System.Exception ('External key string is not valid.') when the recomputed sum does not equal the leading checksum; it also throws a System.Exception ('External key string has been corrupted.') if either checksum character falls outside the encoding alphabet.
